name: Directional Light Wrap on Player Edges
purpose: Blend foreground player naturally into bright outdoor environment lights.
trigger_conditions: Player keyed over bright background or illuminated by strong sun
required_visual_conditions: Strong contrast difference between foreground and background.
fusion_node_structure: Foreground -> MatteDilate1 -> Subtract -> BackgroundBlur -> Merge1 (Screen) over Foreground
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page: Create LightWrap macro spilling background colors inward over character outline.
qa_procedure: Ensure light wrap does not wash out player face or weapon details.
